events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion v Arsenal
events.selectedSentence: Brighton's goals-by-committee attack against Arsenal's first title defence in 22 years: one result will move two very different season stories.
events.fullSpiel: Brighton & Hove Albion arrives with 1W-0D-1L, while Arsenal brings 2 wins from 2.
